lines.beaver: 김민수 님, 수술 후에 몸은 좀 어떠세요?
lines.beaver_en: Mr. Kim Minsu, how are you feeling after the surgery?
lines.beaver_roman: Gimminsu nim, susul hue momeun jom eotteoseyo?
lines.learner: 후유증 때문에 매일 녹초가 될 지경이에요.
lines.en: The aftereffects leave me utterly exhausted every day.
lines.roman: Huyujeung ttaemune maeil nokchoga doel jigyeongieyo.

lines.beaver: 위암 수술 후에 흔한 일입니다. 구토는 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: That's common after stomach cancer surgery. Any vomiting?
lines.beaver_roman: Wiam susul hue heunhan irimnida. Gutoneun itseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 속이 울렁거리고 하루에 두 번 구토해요.
lines.en: Yes, I feel queasy and vomit twice a day.
lines.roman: Ne, sogi ulleonggeorigo harue du beon gutohaeyo.

lines.en: Last week I fainted briefly in the bathroom.

lines.beaver: 빈혈 수치도 낮습니다. 그래서 어지러우셨을 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: Your anemia levels are low too. That's why you were dizzy.
lines.beaver_roman: Binhyeol suchido natseumnida. Geuraeseo eojireousyeosseul geoyeyo.
lines.learner: 밤에는 다리에 경련이 나서 못 잘 지경이에요.
lines.en: At night my legs cramp so much I can hardly sleep.
lines.roman: Bameneun darie gyeongnyeoni naseo mot jal jigyeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any other uncomfortable symptoms?
lines.learner: 오른쪽 귀가 잘 안 들려요. 난청일까요?
lines.en: I can't hear well in my right ear. Is it hearing loss?
lines.roman: Oreunjjok gwiga jal an deullyeoyo. Nancheongilkkayo?

lines.beaver: 항암 치료 후에 청력이 떨어지기도 합니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hearing can sometimes drop after chemotherapy.
lines.beaver_roman: Hangam chiryo hue cheongnyeogi tteoreojigido hamnida.
lines.learner: 혹시 뇌졸중 같은 병이 생긴 건 아닐까요?
lines.en: Could I have gotten something like a stroke?
lines.roman: Hoksi noejoljung gateun byeongi saenggin geon anilkkayo?

lines.beaver_en: The tests show no such signs, so don't worry.
lines.learner: 수술 부위가 곪은 것 같아서 걱정돼요.
lines.en: I'm worried the surgical wound is festering.
lines.roman: Susul buwiga golmeun geot gataseo geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll check whether germs got into the wound.
lines.en: My cough is bad too. It's not pneumonia, is it?

lines.beaver: 폐는 깨끗합니다. 악성 종양 재발 징후도 없습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Your lungs are clear. No sign of the malignant tumor returning.
lines.beaver_roman: Pyeneun kkaekkeutamnida. Akseong jongyang jaebal jinghudo eopseumnida.
lines.en: What a relief. I guess I worried too much.

lines.beaver: 걱정되실 만해요. 다음 주에 다시 뵙겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: It's understandable. I'll see you again next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Geokjeongdoesil manhaeyo. Daeum jue dasi boepgetseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 선생님. 감사합니다. 다음 주에 뵐게요.
lines.en: Yes, doctor. Thank you. See you next week.
lines.roman: Ne, seonsaengnim. Gamsahamnida. Daeum jue boelgeyo.
